newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen offering to sell dollars again in forward trading on Monday to cap the U.S. unit's rise against the won, traders said.
The central bank offered to sell at 897.00 won in one-month forward trading and at 900.50 won in two-month forward trading, they said.
The central bank denied the talk of interventions as it routinely does.
Shortly after the offer, the won was trading at 892.60 against the dollar, compared with an opening rate of 894.70.
The central bank had intervened in spot and forward trading earlier this morning, cushioning the won's losses, dealers said.
